newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil stable in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil stable in thin volume.

text.p: European gas oil cargo spreads were stable in modest volumes on Monday, traders said.
A flexi cargo of low sulphur diesel moved at September IPE +$4.50 cif Le Havre for August 16-23, around unchanged from Friday's values.
German quality heating oil was offered at August IPE +$0.50 and offered at +$1.50, easier than Friday's traded level of August IPE +$2.
Last week's talk of a shortage of stored heating oil in northwest Europe was dismissed by several traders, with one calling it "hype". They argue that Russian material would be plentiful.
Others maintain EN590 takes the lion's share of storage.
"There is a lot of oil around in Europe and not a lot of deamnd worth talking about," said one.
Russian heating oil cargoes are offered at August IPE +$0.50 and bid at -$0.50.

Barges were again dormant. Business was stalled by the high dollar, which was near a new 7-1/2 year high at 1.8465 marks and uncertainty about the influence on screen values of news about progress in resuming Iraqi crude exports.
